name: beats: a long sentence that ends by saying where the thing is written (", per the closed Deadlines section ...") is cut before that tail, and the tail is said as a sentence of its own ("That's per the ..."); a short sentence with such a tail is left whole; "per" as a rate ("twelve dollars, per transcript") is no place to cut

sentences.a long tail: Advisors must submit their requirements by December 1, sixteen days from today, per the closed Deadlines section under Important Dates.
sentences.a short one: Certificates from previous years aren't accepted, per the annual recognition section of this FAQ.
sentences.a rate: It costs twelve dollars, per transcript, for each PDF you order through USC Parchment Services for the program's own office.
